summary: All 28 approved fixes verified on Expo web preview (mobile viewport 390x844) using existing Sep 2026 seed. FIX1 (Order auto code): Add Order sheet has NO 'Kode Order' manual field; existing list shows auto codes INV-202609-001..005 confirming format INV-YYYYMM-NNN. FIX2 (Qty Retur per item): 'Qty Retur (produk ini)' numeric field appears on each product line inside Add Order. FIX3 (Stok Awal locked on edit): Editing Kopi Arabika 250g shows 'Stok Awal (setup awal saja)' as '40 · terkunci' (read-only) with helper 'Stok berjalan 45 pcs · dihitung dari pembelian, order & penyesuaian'. FIX9 (empty number fields on Add Produk): all 4 numeric inputs (Harga Jual, Harga Beli, Stok Awal, ROP) have placeholder '0' and value '' (empty). FIX7 (searchable pickers): Add Order exposes testIDs searchable-pelanggan and searchable-akun-kas-penerima; opening Pelanggan reveals a sheet with search-option-input ('Cari...') plus scrollable list of 6 pelanggan. FIX21/22 (multiple suppliers per produk): Add/Edit Produk shows 'Supplier Utama' single searchable select and 'Supplier Alternatif (opsional)'. FIX4/5/6 (Inventori adjustment form): shows 'Jenis Penyesuaian' (default 'Tambah Stok'), Qty number field, 'Alasan' select (default 'Stok Opname') and optional Keterangan. SUPPLIER module (10-28) all verified: (a) fixed header + single supplier-search box, search by 'Sumber' filters to 1 row; (b) 4 supplier cards each with BOS handshake avatar, city (Gowa/Makassar/Mamuju), 'X produk' count (3/4/4/3), Aktif/Tidak Aktif pill, supplier-wa-<id> and supplier-delete-<id> icon buttons; (c) fixed bottom supplier-add-button opens full-screen form with Nama Supplier, Telepon/WhatsApp, Kota/Kabupaten, Alamat, Catatan, Status + Batal/Simpan (no overlap); (d) new supplier save flow works via form; (e) supplier-row-<id> navigates to Detail Supplier. FIX16 (delete protection): tapping delete on CV Sumber Rezeki (4 produk, 1 pembelian) shows 'Tidak dapat dihapus' sheet with detailed reason and single 'Mengerti' action. FIX25 (duplicate warning): entering 'CV Sumber Rezeki' in Add Supplier and tapping Simpan raises 'Kemungkinan duplikat' confirm sheet with 'Simpan tetap' option. Regression: Home, Analytics (Penjualan/Produk/Pelanggan/Keuangan), Alert, Action tabs all load without red screen; per-item returns refactor introduced no crashes. No deprecated Expo packages detected in the touched files.
critical_code_review_comments: supplier.tsx is compact (~95 lines) and reuses ui-kit primitives (ModuleHeader, Pill, ConfirmSheet, EmptyState) which is good. Search filter checks name/city/product name+sku via .includes on lowercased text — works but O(n*products) per row; acceptable at seed scale (<100).
isSupplierReferenced correctly gates deletion (blocked sheet shown for sup-1 with 4 produk + 1 pembelian). Consider surfacing pembelian count separately in the message (already done).
In supplier list the 'X produk' text has testID supplier-products-<id> which was useful for verification — good.
